mapper.insert: insert into payslip (batch_id, employee_id, contract_id, payslip_status, net_pay, status) values (#{batchId}, #{employeeId}, #{contractId}, #{payslipStatus}, #{netPay}, #{status})
mapper.select: select p.*, e.employee_code, e.full_name from payslip p join employee e on e.employee_id = p.employee_id where p.batch_id = #{batchId} order by e.employee_code
select p.*, e.employee_code, e.full_name from payslip p join employee e on e.employee_id = p.employee_id where p.payslip_id = #{payslipId}
